name: phase-session-archive-governance
description: Add reference-safe completed-phase session archiving and active-session-root checks to existing phase-based projects.
patchTargets: docs/agent_sessions/README.md or existing mapped session-root README when present
notes: Use only for projects that manage work by explicit phases or milestones.
The feature adds governance and checks; it does not move session files automatically.
Existing session-root mappings, immutable references, and audit requirements must be preserved.
